description: This Java source file defines the ShutdownReasonFactory class, which creates instances of ShutdownReason based on JSON input or specific purge reasons. It provides static methods to parse JSON objects into ShutdownReason objects, generate reasons for purging namespaces or entities, and includes internal logic for handling different shutdown reasons. The class is part of the package related to Eclipse Ditto signals commands.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating instances of ShutdownReason based on JSON input or specific reasons such as namespace purge or entity purge.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ShutdownReason instance from a JSON object, determining the type of reason (purge namespace, purge entities, or none) based on the JSON content.

methods.name: getReasonType
methods.description: Helper method to extract the reason type from a JSON object, returning a ShutdownReasonType object.

methods.name: getPurgeNamespaceReason
methods.description: Returns a ShutdownReason representing the purging of a namespace.

methods.name: getPurgeEntitiesReason
methods.description: Returns a ShutdownReason representing the purging of specific entities.
